title: Mad Science Presents: Digging for Dinos
description:
Date: Monday, August 10, 2026
Time: 3:30pm - 4:30pm
Location: Miller Branch

Step into the world of prehistoric giants as young scientists dig, discover, and uncover the secrets of dinosaurs! In this interactive Mad Science workshop, kids become junior paleontologists as they explore real-world fossil science, examine cast fossils, and learn how scientists use clues from the past to understand how dinosaurs lived, moved, and roamed the Earth.

title: New Jersey Symphony Comes to JCFPL: ABC's of My Feelings & Music
description:
Date: Wednesday, August 12, 2026
Time: 2:00pm - 3:00pm
Location: Miller Branch

The New Jersey Symphony Chamber Players present ABCs of My Feelings and Music. This thoughtful program explores the powerful connection between music and emotion, inviting audiences to discover how sound can express what we feel inside. The program journeys through a range of contrasting emotions—revealing how they can be seen, felt, and heard through the elements of music. Featuring a string trio, this program brings beloved classical works to life while encouraging listeners of all ages to recognize, name, and experience emotions through the universal language of music.

title: Zentangle with Miss Zoe
description:
Date: Tuesday, August 11, 2026
Time: 4:00pm - 5:00pm
Location: Heights Branch

Miss Zoe (the new Heights Branch Children's Librarian) will be leading an hour of quiet doodling/drawing with relaxing instrumental music.

Zentangle is a style of art consisting repeating patterns where the end result appears like an optical illusion. Young artists will be encouraged to trust their gut, relax, and make the pattern of the day their own!

Children and teens (between the ages of 6 and 17) are welcome to attend this free program which will be held in the Community Room (downstairs of the Heights Branch Library). Capacity is limited to the number of seats in the room (roughly 20).

Caretakers, if your child cannot be trusted with markers, they should not attend this event.

title: Storytime in the Heights
description:
Date: Wednesday, August 12, 2026
Time: 11:00am - 12:00pm
Location: Heights Branch

Join Miss Zoe (the new Heights Branch Children's Librarian) for an hour of singing, stories, and play. 

Children ages 0-5 are welcome!

11 am - Noon on Wednesdays in the Community Room (downstairs)

REGISTRATION REQUIRED (will open 3 days in advance, reminder email sent three hours in advance)

Following the Supercharged Storytimes framework, we will read roughly four books (sandwiched by songs) and spend the last twenty minutes on group social time (playing with blocks or coloring).

This event will run for ages 0-5 on Wednesdays at 11 am through August 19th. Beginning the next week, we will hold storytime twice weekly: once for babies and toddlers ages 0-3 (at 11 am) and once for preschoolers and kindergarteners ages 3-5 (at 3pm). Caretakers should not bring their children to both events in a given week.

title: Zentangle with Miss Zoe
description:
Date: Tuesday, August 18, 2026
Time: 4:00pm - 5:00pm
Location: Heights Branch

Miss Zoe (the new Heights Branch Children's Librarian) will be leading an hour of quiet doodling/drawing with relaxing instrumental music.

Zentangle is a style of art consisting repeating patterns where the end result appears like an optical illusion. Young artists will be encouraged to trust their gut, relax, and make the pattern of the day their own!

Children and teens (between the ages of 6 and 17) are welcome to attend this free program which will be held in the Community Room (downstairs of the Heights Branch Library). Capacity is limited to the number of seats in the room (roughly 20).

Caretakers, if your child cannot be trusted with markers, they should not attend this event.

title: Storytime in the Heights
description:
Date: Wednesday, August 19, 2026
Time: 11:00am - 12:00pm
Location: Heights Branch

Join Miss Zoe (the new Heights Branch Children's Librarian) for an hour of singing, stories, and play. 

Children ages 0-5 are welcome!

11 am - Noon on Wednesdays in the Community Room (downstairs)

REGISTRATION REQUIRED (will open 3 days in advance, reminder email sent three hours in advance)

Following the Supercharged Storytimes framework, we will read roughly four books (sandwiched by songs) and spend the last twenty minutes on group social time (playing with blocks or coloring).

This event will run for ages 0-5 on Wednesdays at 11 am through August 19th. Beginning the next week, we will hold storytime twice weekly: once for babies and toddlers ages 0-3 (at 11 am) and once for preschoolers and kindergarteners ages 3-5 (at 3pm). Caretakers should not bring their children to both events in a given week.
